## Section 1. Proportion og G/G in a population

Read CSV file downloaded from emsembl

```{r}
mxl <- read.csv("class17data.csv")
head(mxl)
```

```{r}
mxl$Genotype <- as.factor(mxl$Genotype)
table(mxl$Genotype)
```

```{r}
table(mxl$Genotype) / nrow(mxl) * 100
```
